source_documents.title: Excited-state intramolecular charge transfer dynamics in 4-methoxy-4′-nitrostilbene: excitation wavelength and solvent dependence

reference_evidence_units.quote: Steadystate spectroscopy reveals strong intramolecular charge transfer (ICT) behavior, with solvatochromic shifts and large Stokes shifts in polar solvents.
reference_evidence_units.subject: MNS

reference_evidence_units.quote: Time-resolved fluorescence measurements show that both polarity and viscosity enhance ICT state stabilization by extending emissive state lifetimes.
reference_evidence_units.subject: MNS
reference_evidence_units.statement: Polarity and viscosity lengthen the ICT emission lifetime.

reference_evidence_units.quote: In the case of toluene, 370 and 310 nm excitations lead to efficient intersystem crossing (ISC) as depicted by a strong and persistent excited state absorption (ESA) band at ∼600 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: MNS
reference_evidence_units.statement: Efficient ISC to a long-lived triplet in toluene.
